mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling other builders to measure every King bearing before fitting it; distinct post ID from the e90post thread already on file, so likely a separate warning thread.

mentions.title: Kings Engine Bearings.... anybody have problems??
mentions.snippet: New thread asking whether other builders have had problems with King engine bearings.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Builder found King thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit both S85 and S65 blocks, a measurable fitment defect on King's largest engine family by revenue.
mentions.replyNote: WebFetch redirected to a tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning page content; could not read within the Step 0 fetch budget.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Diesel Truck Forum buyer-warning thread about King main thrust bearings; search summary ties this to a free-spread spec out of tolerance across 2024-2025 production, reading as recurring rather than a one-off batch.

mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: Builder reports 2024-2025 production King XP bearings out of spec on "free spread," with King's own tech support reportedly recommending the batch be returned.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: Forum thread on reported King bearing failures in Ford 460 builds, including main and rod bearings found damaged after startup with debris in the filter.
